views.name: filtered_preferences
views.body_sql:
SELECT mp.CustomerID, mp.StyleID, ms.StyleName AS style, mp.PreferenceSeq AS rank
FROM Musical_Preferences mp
JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
views.description: preference records filtered to the target preference ranks

views.name: style_preference_counts
views.body_sql: SELECT style, COUNT(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN 1 END) AS count_rank_1, COUNT(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN 1 END) AS count_rank_2, COUNT(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN 1 END) AS count_rank_3 FROM filtered_preferences GROUP BY style
views.description: aggregated counts of preferences grouped by style, combining the counts for each target rank into a single row per style
